reviewed_by: Claude review of OpenRouter alias models pinned to the 8,192-token safe ceiling
reason: OpenRouter alias models (`~deepseek/deepseek-flash-latest` and the other 17 `~author/family-latest` entries) publish an empty endpoint set: the live API returns `{"endpoints": []}` for the alias and 22 routes for its target `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`. `openrouter_route_limits` therefore raised "OpenRouter returned no eligible model endpoints" for every alias, capability verification stored `route_limits_verified: false`, and `resolve_context_limits` clamped the model to `DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW` (8,192) less 2,048 reserved output, so a 27k-token conversation could not dispatch against a model the catalog advertises at 1,048,576. This is not the #362 retention regression: there were never any route limits to retain. The catalog publishes `alias_target.slug`, so discovery now resolves the alias before calling the endpoints API and records `route_limits_source_model`; limits count as verified only while the measured slug is still the alias target, so a family that ships a new model falls back to the safe ceiling until the new target is measured. The four suites selected are the only ones that exercise model descriptors: test_providers covers catalog parsing of `alias_target` and the alias-specific discovery error, test_context covers sizing from target routes and the lapse when the target moves, test_api covers capability verification measuring the target and persisting the measured slug, and test_chat covers the prepare-time route refresh never asking the alias for endpoints.
exclusions: No frontend unit tests: ui/src is untouched, and the wire mapping for the context limits payload is unchanged (no new field reaches the UI). No native tests: no Tauri or catalog-code change. No screenshot baselines: no rendered surface changes. No Playwright: alias sizing depends on the live OpenRouter catalog and endpoint API, which the Playwright stubs do not model, and the real-Core journeys assert conversation behaviour rather than provider route discovery. tests/test_playwright_impact.py is excluded because ui/playwright-impact.json is unchanged. No full suites: the selection is limited to the four v3 suites that touch model descriptors and route limits.
